title: pinus longipedunculata
intro: Pinus longipedunculata, commonly known as Long-fruit Pine, is a species of pine tree native to China. The health benefits of Pinus longipedunculata include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve immune function, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness. The therapeutic actions of Pinus longipedunculata include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and microbial infections. The bioactive constituents of Pinus longipedunculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
